timeline.text: My daily video digest narrated whatever the source article said, no questions asked.
One exaggerated headline, and that claim went straight into a published video.
Like repeating a rumor on camera without calling anyone to confirm it.
Now a research step checks every fact with real Google searches before it's allowed on screen, and only draws a chart when the numbers are real.
Up to twenty-one independent checks per digest, so nothing airs on faith alone.
